title: RAP vs. Standard Decision Engine
description: Compares the Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP) vs. Standard 10-year plan for federal Direct Loans under OBBBA 2025 (effective July 1, 2026). RAP formula: 1–10% of AGI sliding scale (2.5x–4.5x FPL), $10 floor, 30-year forgiveness. Also models PSLF track under RAP.
